summary: Operationalize DPDPA, LGPD and emerging privacy obligations with control maps, risk assessments and workflows. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Data protection compliance turns privacy obligations into controls, records and accountable workflows. For privacy, legal, compliance, security and data-governance professionals, the course covers building an obligations register, mapping requirements to control owners and evidence, and maintaining processing records. Participants also practise assessing privacy risks, designing data-subject request workflows and documenting incident escalation decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who translate privacy obligations into controls, records and decisions across data-processing operations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with personal-data processing, privacy or compliance documentation is expected. No coding or programming is required. The course supports operational analysis and control design; it does not replace jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
